bns:Component.name: Send_SP_PurgeRetention_V2
bns:Component.bns:description: UNVERIFIED - built empirically, no documented Database V2 pattern for calling a zero-argument stored procedure with no result set (references/components/databasev2_connector_operation_component.md documents GET/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/UPSERT against tables, not stored procedures). Modeled as a Standard Update (EXEC EDV_INTEGRATION.SP_PURGE_RETENTION as the query text) rather than a Standard Get, since the procedure returns no result set - closer to a DML execution (Query/Rows Effected/Status response) than a row-returning query. MUST be tested via boomi-test-execute.sh once the SQL Server Database V2 driver (Custom Library) is confirmed attached to the atom; adjust actionType/UpdateType/query if execution proves this guess wrong. T-SQL translation of the prior MySQL profile SP_PurgeRetention_Read_MySQL, which used Database (Legacy)'s dedicated storedProcedure attribute (spread statementType) - Database V2 has no equivalent documented attribute. | built with boomi-companion v1.0.57
